column1: # Single source of truth for the validation workloads.
# Both scripts/capture_valgrind.sh (which produces the simulated traces) and
# scripts/run_perf.sh (which measures the same code on real hardware) read this
# file. Keeping one list is not tidiness: a simulated-versus-measured table is
# meaningless if the two sides ran different problem sizes.
#   name              label used in every report
#   trace_skip        leading data references to discard when tracing (start-up)
# Footprints for stream and pointer_chase exceed the 2 MiB LLC in
# configs/baseline.json so that DRAM behaviour is exercised on both sides.
